items.title: Floating Post Tabs
items.subtitle: Keep up to 5 posts open as bubbles that float over the app, and tap one to land exactly where you left off.

items.title: Following Section
items.subtitle: Give followed users their own section in the subreddit list, and arrange every section in any order you like.

items.title: Feed Shortcut Styles
items.subtitle: Restyle Home, Popular, All, and Moderator Posts with five icon styles and four layouts, or hide the ones you skip.

items.title: Native Glass Search
items.subtitle: Feed search is now the real Liquid Glass bar. It activates in place and scrolls away with the list.

items.title: Microsoft Translator
items.subtitle: A new provider on Azure's free tier, plus a Google fallback so translation survives rate limiting.

items.title: Fixes
items.subtitle: Gallery View no longer runs out of memory on GIFs, match threads load, saved items stop duplicating, and Low Power Mode stops blocking GIF autoplay.
